slots.name: worker preparation ratio
slots.sentence: Roughly 55 people are being prepared for every 100 workers needed nationally, they said.

slots.name: Ryan apprenticeship duration
slots.sentence: After six months in the union apprenticeship and a brief stint with a non-union contractor, Ryan walked away from the trade.

slots.name: apprenticeship completion ratio
slots.sentence: Even if a person starts one, only 48 out of 100 complete it and just 29 enter a trade occupation within five years of leaving the apprenticeship.

slots.name: counselor view of trade school value
slots.sentence: At 71% and 81%, respectively, most teens and parents said they would be proud if they or their child pursued a skilled trade, and 95% of counselors view trade school as valuable and credible, the research found.

slots.name: counselor recommend apprenticeship rate
slots.sentence: Yet it also revealed a minority (28%) of counselors recommend apprenticeship.

slots.name: post-secondary transition to skilled trade rate
slots.sentence: Among those who enter a related post-secondary program, 48 out of 100 finish, and 34 go on to work in a skilled trade.

slots.name: parents AI school investment view
slots.sentence: Nearly 3 in 5 parents said AI is making school "a worse investment" in a WalletHub survey earlier this year.
